name: Note-card lower third
oneliner: Your name on a little paper note, slightly tilted, with a fine line in your accent.
description: A soft paper card in your brand colours with a strip of tape, your name in your display font and one line about you underneath. Feels handmade, like a note pinned to the counter.
prompt: Render with engines/overlays.py, item kind "lower_third", for 2.5-3.5s when the speaker first says their name or business (or at 1.5s if they never do). Copy: "name" (up to 20 characters) and "detail" (up to 22 characters), from the profile; never guess a name or title, and anything you write is flagged for approval. Look: a paper note in the brand background colour, min 560px and up to 800px wide, left edge at x=72, top at y=850, rotated -2 degrees, soft shadow, a strip of tape in the brand secondary colour on the top edge. Name in {{font.display}} 700, 76px (no less than 64px); a 2px {{brand.accent}} hairline rule; detail in {{font.body}} 400, 64px, at 82% opacity. Motion: slides in 60px from the left while turning from -6 to -2 degrees over 600ms (power3 out), the rule wipes in 250ms later, the detail fades in; out: slides left and fades over 300ms. It stays above the caption band (59-73% of the height) and off the right 140px; it sits on the chest, never on the face.
